== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Symbiosis]].
* Works well with party members that stack enchantments (e.g. [[bonder]]s) or with party-wide enchantments (e.g. [[Order of the Vampire]]).
* Be ready for a sudden drop in maximum and current health whenever the spirit dies or the party leaves the area.
